data.text: Bow: Fresh Textures items/bow.json and crossbow.json route the in-hand display contexts to Fresh's own 3D models (textures bow_model, arrow_bow_model, ...). The higher Stylus's Bow Retexture only replaces item/bow*.png, so the held bow showed Fresh's look. Fix: built resourcepacks/Fresh Bow Compat.zip with vanilla 26.3 items/bow.json, items/crossbow.json and models/item/bow*, crossbow* (min 97, max 200), and inserted it right above Fresh in options.txt (backup options.txt.pre-bowcompat). Owner to verify in game.
